name: PM YASASVI - Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT Students for studying in India
provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India (implemented through States/UTs)

rules.quote: The scholarships will be open to Indian nationals belonging to OBCs, EBCs and DNTs, as notified by the Central Govt./State Govt./ UT Admin.
Unemployed students whose parents/guardians income from all sources does not exceed Rs. 2.50 lakh per annum will be entitled for the scholarship under the scheme.

value: post-matric: Class XI-XII, ITI, diploma, UG, PG, MPhil/PhD
rules.quote: Scholarships will be given for the study of all recognized post-matriculation or post- secondary courses (Intermediate/Senior Secondary, Diploma, long-term Vocational Training Certificate, Graduate, Post Graduate courses etc.)

rules.value: awarded by the State/UT where the student is permanently settled
rules.quote: These scholarships shall be available for studies in India only and will be awarded by the Government of State/Union Territory to which the applicant actually belongs, i.e. permanently settled.
Only Institutions/Colleges with the 'AISHE Code'/UDISE' Code' shall be eligible for the scholarship scheme.

Candidates who, after passing one stage of education, are studying in the same stage of education in different subject e.g. B.Sc. after B.A or B.Com.after B.A. or M.A. in a subject after M.A in another subject will not be eligible.

rules.value: max two boys per family; no limit for girls
rules.quote: Only two boys of the same parents/guardian will be entitled to receive scholarships. This restriction will, however, not apply to girls.
A scholarship holder under this Scheme will not hold any other scholarship/ stipend.

rules.value: correspondence/online students eligible (tuition fee only, no academic allowance)
rules.quote: Students, who pursue their studies through correspondence/online courses, are also eligible.

rules.value: 30% funds for girls, 5% for students with disabilities
rules.quote: 12.4 30% of the funds allocated earmarked for girl students and 5% for students with disabilities.

rules.value: management/NRI quota and spot admission seats not eligible
rules.quote: All seats filled through arbitrary and non-transparent processes (including management quota, NRI quota, spot admissions etc.) without following the merit criteria as decided by the State Government are not eligible for these scholarships.

amount.text: Yearly academic allowance plus tuition fee: Group 1 Rs 10,000 + 10,000 = 20,000; Group 2 Rs 8,000 + 5,000 = 13,000; Group 3 Rs 6,000 + 2,000 = 8,000; Group 4 Rs 5,000 (freeship card for admission without pre-payment of fees)
amount.quote: Group 1: Degree and Post Graduate level professional courses 10000 10000 20000 Group 2: Other Professional Courses leading to Degree, Diploma, Certificate 8000 5000 13000 Group 3: Graduate and Post Graduate courses not covered under Group I & Group II 6000 2000 8000 Group 4: All post-matriculation (Post Class X level) non-degree courses 5000 0 5000

documents.name: Passport size photograph
documents.quote: the documents may be scanned and uploaded which include: passport size photograph

documents.name: Certificates of all examinations passed
documents.quote: copy of each of the certificates for diploma, degree etc. in respect of all examinations passed

documents.name: Caste certificate
documents.quote: Caste certificate duly signed by the authorized officer

documents.name: Income certificate
documents.quote: valid Income certificate issued by the competent

deadline.text: States/UTs announce from April each year and fix the last date; applications on the State scholarship portal or NSP
deadline.quote: All the State Governments/UT Administrations will announce starting from April, the details of the Scheme and invite applications by issuing an advertisement in the leading newspapers of the State and through their respective websites/ Scholarship portals and other modes of media.
